Limit[n=15]
  Sort[keys=l.extended_price DESC]
    Project[l.id AS line_id, p.name AS part_name, p.brand AS brand, l.quantity AS quantity, l.extended_price AS extended_price, p.retail_price AS retail_price]
      Filter[p.brand = 'Brand#11' AND l.quantity >= 20]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=l.part_id = p.id]
          Scan[lineitem]
          Scan[part]
